verses.en: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.
verses.pt: Eu sou a rosa de Sarom, o lírio dos vales.
verses.en_web: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.
verses.en_bbe: I am a rose of Sharon, a flower of the valleys.

verses.en: As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
verses.pt: Qual o lírio entre os espinhos, tal é a minha amada entre as filhas.
verses.en_web: As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
verses.en_bbe: As the lily-flower among the thorns of the waste, so is my love among the daughters.

verses.en: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.
verses.pt: Qual a macieira entre as árvores do bosque, tal é o meu amado entre os filhos; com grande gozo sentei-me à sua sombra; e o seu fruto era doce ao meu paladar.
verses.en_web: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.
verses.en_bbe: As the apple-tree among the trees of the wood, so is my loved one among the sons. I took my rest under his shade with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.

verses.en: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.
verses.pt: Levou-me à sala do banquete, e o seu estandarte sobre mim era o amor.
verses.en_web: He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.
verses.en_bbe: He took me to the house of wine, and his flag over me was love.

verses.en: Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I am sick of love.
verses.pt: Sustentai-me com passas, confortai-me com maçãs, porque desfaleço de amor.
verses.en_web: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; For I am faint with love.
verses.en_bbe: Make me strong with wine-cakes, let me be comforted with apples; I am overcome with love.

verses.en: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.
verses.pt: A sua mão esquerda esteja debaixo da minha cabeça, e a sua mão direita me abrace.
verses.en_web: His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.
verses.en_bbe: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand is round about me.

verses.en: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
verses.pt: Conjuro-vos, ó filhas de Jerusalém, pelas gazelas e cervas do campo, que não acordeis nem desperteis o amor, até que ele o queira.
verses.en_web: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
verses.en_bbe: I say to you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes of the field, do not let love be moved till it is ready.

verses.en: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.
verses.pt: A voz do meu amado! eis que vem aí, saltando sobre os montes, pulando sobre os outeiros.
verses.en_web: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.
verses.en_bbe: The voice of my loved one! See, he comes dancing on the mountains, stepping quickly on the hills.

verses.en: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.
verses.pt: O meu amado é semelhante ao gamo, ou ao filho do veado; eis que está detrás da nossa parede, olhando pelas janelas, lançando os olhos pelas grades.
verses.en_web: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.
verses.en_bbe: My loved one is like a roe; see, he is on the other side of our wall, he is looking in at the windows, letting himself be seen through the spaces.

verses.en: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.
verses.pt: Fala o meu amado e me diz: Levanta-te, amada minha, formosa minha, e vem.
verses.en_web: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.
verses.en_bbe: My loved one said to me, Get up, my love, my fair one, and come away.

verses.en: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;
verses.pt: Pois eis que já passou o inverno; a chuva cessou, e se foi;
verses.en_web: For, behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.
verses.en_bbe: For, see, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;

verses.en: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
verses.pt: aparecem as flores na terra; já chegou o tempo de cantarem as aves, e a voz da rola ouve-se em nossa terra.
verses.en_web: The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
verses.en_bbe: The flowers are come on the earth; the time of cutting the vines is come, and the voice of the dove is sounding in our land;

verses.en: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs, and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.
verses.pt: A figueira começa a dar os seus primeiros figos; as vides estão em flor e exalam o seu aroma. Levanta-te, amada minha, formosa minha, e vem.
verses.en_web: The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”
verses.en_bbe: The fig-tree puts out her green fruit and the vines with their young fruit give a good smell. Get up from your bed, my beautiful one, and come away.

verses.en: O my dove, that art in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs, let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; for sweet is thy voice, and thy countenance is comely.
verses.pt: Pomba minha, que andas pelas fendas das penhas, no oculto das ladeiras, mostra-me o teu semblante faze-me ouvir a tua voz; porque a tua voz é doce, e o teu semblante formoso.
verses.en_web: My dove in the clefts of the rock, In the hiding places of the mountainside, Let me see your face. Let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet, and your face is lovely.
verses.en_bbe: O my dove, you are in the holes of the mountain sides, in the cracks of the high hills; let me see your face, let your voice come to my ears; for sweet is your voice, and your face is fair.

verses.en: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
verses.pt: Apanhai-nos as raposas, as raposinhas, que fazem mal às vinhas; pois as nossas vinhas estão em flor.
verses.en_web: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom.
verses.en_bbe: Take for us the foxes, the little foxes, which do damage to the vines; our vines have young grapes.

verses.en: My beloved is mine, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.
verses.pt: O meu amado é meu, e eu sou dele; ele apascenta o seu rebanho entre os lírios.
verses.en_web: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.
verses.en_bbe: My loved one is mine, and I am his: he takes his food among the flowers.

verses.en: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.
verses.pt: Antes que refresque o dia, e fujam as sombras, volta, amado meu, e faze-te semelhante ao gamo ou ao filho dos veados sobre os montes de Beter.
verses.en_web: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether.
verses.en_bbe: Till the evening comes, and the sky slowly becomes dark, come, my loved one, and be like a roe on the mountains of Bether.
